column1: # hdr: input = <file hex>:<position>; result = ok:<width>,<height>,<x>,<y>,<flags>,<extra>,<size 8 or 12> | err:truncated:<position>

# image: input = <file hex>:<offset>; result = ok:<width>,<height>,<x>,<y>,<flags>,<extra>,<header size>,<offset>,<encoded data length>,<end offset>;<pixels: T transparent, S shadow, [hh] palette index; - when the image has more than 70000 pixels> | err:truncated:<position>
# images: input = <file hex, or file:<path>>; result = ok:<magic>,<version>:<image>|<image>... (each as for image, or err:truncated:<position> for the last) | err:...
# indexed: input = <file hex>:<comma-separated offsets>; result = ok:<entry>|<entry>... (none, or as for image) | err:...

# jobs: input = <jil offsets>:<dil offsets>:<gil length> (comma-separated decimals); result = J(<direction>;<direction>...) per job separated by spaces, each direction a comma-separated list of frame numbers
